name: Kubelet Configuration Files Permissions 600 or Stricter
description: Ensures the kubelet config file and kubeconfig (/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml, /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf) are owned by root:root with mode 600 or stricter. Passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when no kubelet is running.

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^kubelet$'; then stat -c '%n %a %U %G' /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf 2>/dev/null; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
